scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend && npm --prefix desktop-pos run typecheck && tsc --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run test:setup && npm run test:backup && npm run test:startup && npm run test:boot && npm run test:local -w backend && npm run test:unit -w frontend
scripts.check:local: npm run test:backup && npm run test:startup && npm run test:boot && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run check:scripts -w backend && npm run test:local -w backend && node scripts/maintenance/check-build-path.ts
scripts.lint: eslint --config config/eslint/eslint.config.js backend/src frontend/src shared api backend/api/index.ts scripts backend/scripts desktop-pos/src desktop-pos/electron desktop-pos/build desktop-pos/scripts desktop-pos/tests config "frontend/*config*.{js,ts}" "backend/*config*.{js,ts}" "desktop-pos/*config*.{js,ts}"
scripts.lint:fix: eslint --config config/eslint/eslint.config.js --fix backend/src frontend/src shared api backend/api/index.ts scripts backend/scripts desktop-pos/src desktop-pos/electron desktop-pos/build desktop-pos/scripts desktop-pos/tests config "frontend/*config*.{js,ts}" "backend/*config*.{js,ts}" "desktop-pos/*config*.{js,ts}"
scripts.format: prettier --ignore-path config/prettier/.prettierignore --write backend frontend desktop-pos shared scripts config api .github package.json package-lock.json vercel.json tsconfig.json docker-compose.yml
scripts.format:check: prettier --ignore-path config/prettier/.prettierignore --check backend frontend desktop-pos shared scripts config api .github package.json package-lock.json vercel.json tsconfig.json docker-compose.yml
